data_fields.name: idle_static_repeats
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 to 20 repeats of the static clip per phrase

data_fields.name: idle_walk_cycles
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 to 5 walk clips per moving phrase

data_fields.name: idle_move_weights
data_fields.donor_constant: list entries as weights: STATIC 2, MOVING 2, IDLE 1, each melee and ranged 1; death clips WNCE 1 and KILL 1 only when asked

data_fields.name: idle_frame_gap
data_fields.donor_constant: 150 ms per animation frame (display gate, wall clock)

data_fields.name: idle_gate_prime
data_fields.donor_constant: pass() backdates the gate by two periods so the first poll passes

data_fields.name: idle_phase_sequence
data_fields.donor_constant: 15-entry sequence 0,0,1,2,1,0,0,0,3,4,5,4,3,0,0, phase from position (x*y or x+y+day)

best_idea: Show creature idle variety as a queue of weighted phrases (each a rest, a walk or a strike, then a rest clip), with the weights written as duplicates in the clip list, so no two creatures of one type look copied and the server never has to send idle choices.
decision_why: The phrase queue and weighted pick fit zone creature idle, but the donor's wall-clock gate and unseeded RNG are display choices that must not touch anything the server checks, so we drive the queue from the shared client clock and keep the RNG out of the engine; the donor also mixes wince and death clips into idle lists, which we must keep to server events only.
acceptance: In one zone with 12 idle creatures of one type, no two share the same phrase boundary within 5 seconds, and with no server hit event the wince clip never plays; a server hit event plays the wince clip on the same frame in every client.
